svg.font-family: JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
svg.aria-label: A floating waybar whose media pill shows a small podcast cover and Slow Signals · Where the Night Trains…, cut at a word with a real ellipsis. A click on the cover opens the Tannoy drawer out of it: the podcast playing in Chrome with its scrub bar moving, play and pause, previous and next, and 15 second skips. A click on +15 jumps ahead. A click on the Spotify chip swaps the cover, the title and the bar pill to a song, the skips give way to shuffle and repeat toggles, and play starts it. Do not disturb turns on: the bell turns amber, the bar keeps only a dim music glyph, and the drawer says the title is hidden while its controls stay. Do not disturb turns off again, and a click outside closes the drawer.

g.text: Slow Signals · Where the Night Trains…
